Kotak Alts Closes ₹5,000 Crore Fund from Domestic Investors

Kotak Alternate Asset Managers (Alts) has closed its Kotak Yield & Growth Fund at ₹5,000 crore. The fund was raised entirely from domestic investors, including institutional investors, family offices, and Ultra High-Net-Worth Individuals (UHNIs) across India. It will focus on investments in private credit, real assets, and selective growth opportunities, targeting cash-flow-generating businesses and mid-to-large-sized enterprises.
